corrected_key17.expected_answer: Match the depicted printed-standard-size category: 2− accepts printed requirement 1 or 2, 3 accepts exactly 3, and 4+ accepts 4 or 5. Do not release an animal from a different size band; actual occupied enclosure size and special-enclosure capacity do not set its band. Lose only printed appeal before conservation reward; discard animal losing icons, retain earned ability appeal, reputation/conservation and past effects. Must remove the indicated special-enclosure tokens if the released animal is eligible and the required tokens can be removed; only otherwise flip smallest occupied standard meeting all requirements, fallback to size-only then none if none fits. This applies to flock animals too.
